answer: Sybil resistance can come from vouching with skin in the game: an existing agent may sponsor a newcomer only by locking a bond that is slashed if the newcomer is convicted of fake grading or duplicate identities. A vertex in this trust graph therefore risks real value, a dune of cheap sock-puppets collapses because no sponsor will stake on all of them, and a pearl of genuine reputation is earned only when sponsored agents behave honestly over time.
